1.why: The application uses a legible typeface with clean line spacing across screens.

2.why: Text blocks are concise and avoid extensive italics or all-caps styling.

3.why: The single-column layout fits well within mobile screen bounds.

4.why: Instructions are written in short, straightforward sentences.

5.why: Input fields contain explicit placeholder text illustrating expected entries.

6.why: Information is presented in brief callout panels rather than dense text blocks.

7.why: No dedicated copy buttons are visible for secrets or generated recovery codes.

8.why: The interface provides text setup keys but lacks a scannable QR code.

9.why: Standard form fields are present, though browser autofill settings are unconfirmed.

10.why: Step counters and prominent blue primary buttons clearly indicate progress.

11.why: Each screen limits user action to a single primary button press.

12.why: Green confirmation banners state the outcome of completed actions clearly.

13.why: Recovery codes can be regenerated, though code visibility toggles are absent.

14.why: The displayed error banner is generic and omits detailed fix instructions.

15.why: Setup includes a five-minute time limit alongside standard TOTP windows.
